title: Liveness readers treat a closed session as not live

truths: A session record with status "closed" is not counted by active_worker_session_ids, reads stale in claims.rs heartbeat_stale, and does not hold a worktree in live_session_holds
perform_cleanup removes a worktree whose only holding session is closed
A fresh heartbeat on a closed record clears status/closed_at and stamps revived_at, mirroring the dead-revival path

action: Make a status of "closed" (alongside the existing "dead") read as not-live at every work-gating session-liveness site: (1) packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/write_guard/store.rs active_worker_session_ids — skip records whose status is closed or dead before the heartbeat_stale check; (2) packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/claims.rs heartbeat_stale (the session-map one at ~line 598 feeding is_concurrent_mode) — status closed/dead returns stale=true; (3) packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/prune.rs live_session_holds — a record with status closed/dead does not hold (keep the existing unreadable-record fail-closed behavior); this automatically covers merge cleanup's liveness check. (4) packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/state_sync.rs heartbeat_session — clear status/closed_at on revival exactly as it clears dead/dead_at (extend the existing D8 block; stamp revived_at). Do NOT touch the throttle-only heartbeat_stale in state_sync.rs:463. Tests: one per touched predicate — closed record excluded from active_worker_session_ids; closed record reads stale in claims.rs; closed record does not hold in live_session_holds (and thus perform_cleanup removes); heartbeat clears closed and stamps revived_at.
intent: A closed mark is only useful if the guards that count live workers, concurrent mode, and worktree holds all release on it; revival on heartbeat keeps a resumed same-id session safe.

trace.outcome: Closed sessions now release every work-gating liveness reader (active-worker count, concurrent mode, write-guard ownership, claim/reservation adoption, worktree holds) and revive cleanly on a fresh heartbeat
trace.inline_reason: worker dispatched directly by orchestrator without a bee state worker add registration step; cell claim and reservations were already owned under this worker's claim_session per cells show
